                                                                    VIN CONVERSION (Vehicle Identification Number)
The VIN plate is located on the front of the dashboard on the drivers (LH) side of the vehicle, and is visible         It is always important to verify the country of origin and the model year the vehicle was manufactured,
by looking into the vehicle through the windshield.                                                                    and this is especially important when working on vehicles that require/could require transponder keys.

                                                                                                        TYPICAL VIN
                1           K           3           L           P           2           5           R             S           2           1           3        2          4          3           0          0
                                      1st Character = Country of Origin                                                                             10th Character = Model Year
           1 – USA                  J – Japan          K – Korea          W– Germany                                    A – 1980 / 2010         J – 1988 / 2018  T – 1996                   4 – 2004
           2 – Canada               K – Korea          L – China,Taiwan   Y – Belgium, Finland,                         B – 1981 / 2011         K – 1989 / 2019  V – 1997                   5 – 2005
           3 – Mexico               L – China,Taiwan   M – Thailand           Sweden                                    C – 1982 / 2012         L – 1990 / 2020  W– 1998                    6 – 2006
           4 – USA                  M – Thailand       S – Great Brittan  Z – Italy                                     D – 1983 / 2013         M – 1991 / 2021  X – 1999                   7 – 2007
           5 – USA                  6 – Australia      V – France, Spain,                                               E – 1984 / 2014         N – 1992 / 2022  Y – 2000                   8 – 2008
           6 – Australia            J – Japan              Yugoslavia                                                   F – 1985 / 2015         P – 1993 / 2023  1 – 2001                   9 – 2009
                                                                                                                        G – 1986 / 2016         R – 1994 / 2024  2 – 2002
